description: USE AFTER EXCEPTION OBJECT (Format 4) - a 2002 introduction (the EC-OO declarative). The in-window fixture needs a class-name operand, which requires an OO compilation group - the matrix skips compile assertions (PENDING: activates when the matrix runner gains multi-unit OO fixtures, PHASE 09) while the registry row drives the gate. Folded from the inline ProcedureTableBuilder gate (Exec Step E).
